subject: sentences
title: Commas in dates
about: He looks at three ways of writing the same date and taps the one with the comma between the day and the year. Commas in dates are the one comma rule North Carolina puts in first grade (commas in a series wait until grade 2).
tip: Have him point to the day number and the year and check that the comma sits between them.

cards.q: May fifth, twenty twenty-seven. Which date has the comma in the right place?
cards.note: In a date, the comma goes between the day and the year.
